name: com.ucitsfinder/ucits-finder
title: EU ETF Check
description: EU retail eligibility (PRIIPs) of a ticker and UCITS alternatives to US ETFs. Free, read-only.

tools.name: check_eu_eligibility
tools.description: Says whether a retail investor in the EU/EEA can buy a ticker. US-domiciled ETFs (SPY, QQQ, VTI, GLD...) have no PRIIPs KID, so EU brokers block them for retail clients; for those it returns UCITS ETFs/ETCs listed in Europe that track the same index or underlying, with how close each match is (same_index, same_underlying, approximate) and its structure (UCITS ETF, or ETC/ETP which is EU-buyable but not a UCITS fund). US single stocks and EU-listed tickers are eligible. Information only, not investment advice.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. SPY, QQQ, NVDA, SXR8.DE

tools.name: list_covered_etfs
tools.description: Lists every US ETF for which UCITS alternatives are known, so you can check coverage before asking.
